ModMetaData.name: Colony Kanban
ModMetaData.author: billy
ModMetaData.description:
A small plan / doing / done board for your colony, so you remember what you were working on.
- "Plans" tab on the bottom bar with drag-and-drop tickets - Tickets are saved with your colony - Each ticket shows its in-game age and an optional deadline - Optional see-through reminder of what you're doing, toggled from the bottom-right icons
